columns_never_fillable.reason: The report discloses 'Attributable Lettable Area (sq ft)' for each property, not GLA/NLA separately. The area metric used is Attributable Lettable Area which has been placed in nla. GLA is separately shown as 'Gross Floor Area (sq ft)' for some properties but not consistently across all — not used as gla to avoid inconsistency. See At A Glance pages 40-44.

Per-property NPI is NOT disclosed in this report. NPI is only disclosed at segment level: Fully-fitted (Colocation) S$297.9m, Fully-fitted (Single Tenant) S$58.6m, Shell and Core S$26.8m (page 46). No per-property NPI appears in the Portfolio Statement, the financial notes, or the 'At A Glance' cards.

All clients are fully anonymised per footnotes on page 39: 'The names of the clients cannot be identified and matched to the information set out above as many of the lease arrangements and colocation arrangements contain confidentiality provisions.' No client names appear anywhere in the report.
Per-property trade mix is not disclosed. The report gives portfolio-level trade sector breakdown only (page 39).
All clients are anonymised — only verbatim descriptors provided (e.g. 'Fortune Global 500 Company (Hyperscaler)'). Captured verbatim per schema field instruction.

parsing_traps.trap: KDC SGP 7 and KDC SGP 8 carrying values include lease liabilities from 10-year land tenure extension (S$350m paid Dec 2025). Carrying value on Portfolio Statement (S$750,077k and S$801,759k) includes these capitalised lease liabilities. Card valuation excludes extension: S$744.0m and S$796.0m respectively.
KDC SGP 5 lease term in Portfolio Statement is 39 years, but includes further 9-year extension. Lease expiry is 31 August 2050.

Guangdong DC 1 and 2 gross revenue (S$11.3m each) includes recognition under 'Gross Revenue' and corresponding 'Property Expenses' for loss allowances on uncollected rental income per footnote 3, page 39.
Tokyo DC 3 acquired 19 Nov 2025 — only 1.5 months contribution to FY2025 gross revenue (S$4.6m attributable).

Cashflow hedge reclassification of S$1,949k appears in Note 22 as a credit to finance costs total (reduces net finance costs from S$50,892k to S$48,943k). In income_components.json, this is recorded as an adjustment (positive) rather than reducing a finance expense line.

reconciliation.gross_revenue_gap_note: Per-property gross revenues are 'Attributable Gross Revenue' from At A Glance cards (REIT's share only, SGD millions rounded to 1 d.p.). Sum of 25 active/held-for-sale properties = S$433.5m vs total reported S$441.4m. Gap of ~S$7.9m (~1.8%) is attributable to: (1) Kelsterbach DC partial-year gross revenue Jan-Mar 2025 (divested 24 Mar 2025, not shown in any card since no longer active); (2) rounding to nearest S$0.1m across 25 card disclosures. This is a structural limitation of the card-based per-property gross revenue disclosure.
